record.oneLiner: A common Late Triassic 'prosauropod' of Europe.
record.description: Plateosaurus was an early sauropodomorph ('prosauropod') herbivore of Late Triassic Europe, known from abundant, well-preserved skeletons. It was one of the first dinosaurs to become well understood, and the fifth valid dinosaur genus ever named.

notableFacts.text: Known from abundant, well-preserved skeletons across central Europe.
The fifth still-valid dinosaur genus ever named.
